do.text: Name the field in a word or two ("Email"), and put any guidance in the description.

dont.text: Don't write instructions into the label: put them in the description.

do.text: Mark a required field with `required` on its input, and show the mark beside the label, hidden from screen readers.

dont.text: Don't type a star into the label text alone: screen readers read "star", and the input is not required.
